sloka: इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।प्रनष्टा अपि सती यस्य मनसो न प्रणश्यति ॥५-१५-४८॥
transliteration: iyam kanaka varṇa angī rāmasya mahiṣī priyā ।pranaṣṭā api satī yasya manaso na praṇaśyati ॥5-15-48॥

translations.english: "This lady of golden complexion is Rama's beloved queen who does not disappear from his mind, although away.
